column1: # delegate registry: delegation uids per repository, one per agent (agy, codex).
# Columns: key<TAB>root<TAB>uid<TAB>setup<TAB>note[<TAB>agent uids]
#   key   : repository name in the driver's folders: <state>/work/<key>-<agent>/ and <state>/runs/<key>/
#   root  : main repository path (working tree root)
#   uid   : from 61000 upward. No two repositories share a uid, so a task in one cannot modify the other's worktree.
#           It must not collide with a real user in /etc/passwd (`doctor` checks). agy runs as this uid, and so does
#           every agent the last column does not name.
#   setup : command run once inside the new worktree right after it is created (`-` for none), as the task uid with the
#           task's environment plus mise. Failure only warns.
#   note  : free text for humans (`-` when the last column follows)
#   agent uids : optional, e.g. `codex=61004`: that agent's own uid, so agy and codex of one repository run side by
#           side without reaching each other's files. Rows without it share the uid column and run one at a time.
# A new repository gets the next free uids from `delegate.py register <root>`; on a row without the last column the same
# command adds it. Edit by hand only while no delegation is running.
# register edits this file in place, so it must be a file the user owns (option harness_delegate_registry, or
# HARNESS_DELEGATE_REGISTRY): the copy shipped in the plugin folder is read only, since a plugin update replaces it.
